_notes: Scope: this first cut covers only the harborline-commands-and-pins fact class, not all 10 rows in MANIFEST.md's SSOT ownership table. See JUSTIFICATION.md for why the other 9 were deferred rather than rushed.

'bun test' and 'bun install' were deliberately excluded as patterns: a real grep shows them in 15-20+ files as generic worked-example text (skill traces, checklists, curriculum), not restatements of the harborline fact record. Including them would produce near-total false-positive noise and erode trust in the linter's real findings, the same failure mode GR-6 (description-tuning) warns against for skill descriptions.

REFERENCE-ANCHORS.md is exempt because MANIFEST.md's own SSOT table designates it a 'reference-only toucher (fixture def)' for this fact class - it narrates the GR-2/GR-3 incidents and cannot do so without naming the actual commands.

orchestration/guardrails-template.md is exempt because its one hit ('never run db:migrate') is a generic phrasing example inside a template about how to WRITE guardrail entries, not a claim about harborline's actual command list.

scan_extensions is .md only, matching the fixture default. .jsonl/.py files were excluded because training exemplars and script docstrings need to contain realistic real commands to function as intended - the restatement rule doesn't cleanly apply to them yet.

The two fixtures/ssot/*.md exemptions exist because those files are the linter's own golden test data - they coincidentally reuse 'bun run db:migrate' as their planted-violation string, which collides with this rules file when run against the whole vault root rather than just the content tree. Exempted here rather than solved by re-scoping the invocation, so the rules file gives correct results regardless of what root path it's run against.
